name: Summer Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip
storyline: It's time for the girls' track team to have their summer training camp. This year, you decided to bring the team's top three girls, Saki Tanaka, Chiaki Saitou, and Sanae Satou to a lodge in your hometown. You know you'll need more than a basic training regimen to keep the girls engaged, which is why you have special plans for each of them. How will they react to your attempts to coax the best out of them? What else awaits you and the three girls out in the beautiful countryside lodge? That's up to you to find out!
summary: As coach of the girls' track team, go on an exciting retreat in the countryside with the three best girls of your team, where you'll help them overcome their struggles and unlock their full potential!
